# P31.12 (BREADTH.1): accountability breadth — federal oversight + UK

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.12__accountability-breadth-federal-uk.md` (Round 9
Wave B, manifest row 153). Lands **4 of the 8** `D-R7.3-BREADTH` sources hosted —
the row is annotated **4/8 and stays OPEN** (P31.13 owns `ccops_oakland`,
`ccops_cambridge`, `ccops_somerville`, `fema_hsgp_allocations`). Stacked on the
P31.11 tip `devin/p31-11-review-decisions-into-clustering` (PR #147).

The four P29.3 GL-GATE-07 rights flips were registered and LOADABLE but had no
`CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entry — a live run stopped with `ValueError: no connector
known for source …` before any socket. They now route through the existing
`accountability` connector's new targeted `oversight_report` path: one reviewed
published document per target — a landing page or the report PDF, never an
index, listing, or search surface (SIG-INGEST-036/037).

## Summary

- **`oversight_report` target kind (`connectors/accountability.py`, §22.6-E
  pattern, not a new connector).** `discover` resolves every target to its
  reviewed `live_targets.toml` row by URL and refuses anything else
  (`UnreviewedReportTarget`; enumeration shapes — `mode: crawl/enumerate/list`,
  `page`/`cursor`/`offset` — raise `CrawlAttempted`). The resolved row is
  recorded on `ctx.resolved_targets`, so the reviewed row — never a
  caller-supplied row — is what post-capture stages read (SIG-INGEST-038).
- **Literal-verified capture (§3.1).** `parse` extracts the capture's text —
  `html_text` for landing pages, `pdf_text_pages` for the report PDFs — and
  requires every reviewed `literals` string to survive in it
  (whitespace-folded). A missing literal means the captured document is not the
  reviewed report: `ContentDrift`, fail closed, never a claim asserted beyond
  the capture (the P25.8 live-clause precedent). A text-less PDF is drift too.
- **One `AccountabilityEvent` per reviewed report (§11.17).** `extract` /
  `normalize` emit one event from the reviewed row's fields — `external_id`
  (the report's own product number/slug), `event_type = audit_finding`,
  `epistemic_status`, `event_date`, `organizations`, `technologies`,
  `affected_party_class` — plus the report URL as a `primary_record` evidence
  link (SIG-ONTO-039). An oversight finding is never a deployment, device
  count, or operational-state claim (the predicate allowlist enforces it).
- **Part VIII org refs from day one (P31.5 / ADR-112).** `link()`'s existing
  `partner_ref_rows(…, event_organizations)` appends one entity-ref claim per
  organisation `partner_identity` accepts — role-shaped office names
  ("Biometrics and Surveillance Camera Commissioner") are refused and land as
  the verbatim text claim; no person entities, ever.
- **Reviewed targets (data, not code — SIG-INGEST-038).**
  `live_targets.toml` gains one reviewed row per source: **GAO-21-518**
  "Facial Recognition Technology: Federal Law Enforcement Agencies Should
  Better Assess Privacy and Other Risks" (2021-06-03); **OIG-09-12** "DHS'
  Role in State and Local Fusion Centers Is Evolving" (2008-12); the **FY2021
  National Network of Fusion Centers Assessment Summary of Findings**; and the
  **UK BSCC Annual Report 2022/2023** (GOV.UK accessible edition). Every row
  records its access posture in `review_note` (incl. the recorded — never
  defeated — gao.gov NetScaler 403 posture from this network).
- **Vocabulary `2026.09.26.1`** — the four `[sources]` entries plus the
  `[oversight_report]` block (kind + default `primary_record` source class).
  The version bump restamps record provenance; `tests/partner_fixtures.py`
  gains `golden_digest`, which normalizes the stamp for comparison against the
  P31.5 base-commit golden (raw digests still asserted on the spine).
- **Fixtures.** `tests/connectors/fixtures/oversight_reports/` — trimmed
  verbatim-excerpt HTML captures (GAO via the public Wayback capture — recorded
  honestly in `SOURCES.md`; GOV.UK) and deterministic `minimal_pdf` captures
  carrying the reports' verbatim cover text (the multi-MB upstream PDFs are not
  committed — the CCOPS convention).
- **Cadence.** `ops/cadence.toml` gains four monthly `[[sources]]` rows
  (`sig-ingest-*` + `sig-sched-*`), days 14–17 @ 06:09 UTC; the four stale
  `live_dispositions.toml` rows are removed (mapped sources carry none —
  FEMA's stays for P31.13). `sig-ops cadence --check` green.

## Tests

`tests/connectors/test_oversight_reports.py` — **41 tests**: connector mapping
+ vocab registration per source; the reviewed-row contract; one event +
predicate claims + `primary_record` link per fixture run; org entity-refs
(incl. the refused role-shaped UK commissioner name staying text-only);
per-source ContentDrift on a missing reviewed literal; unreviewed-URL refusal
at `discover` **and** before any socket opens; crawl/pagination refusal;
out-of-vocabulary refusal; shadow-replay diff = 0 per source; replay
byte-reproducibility + parse-level purity.
